# Quality Improvement Action

This folder documents the specific actions healthcare organizations take to address data integrity and reporting challenges identified through quality monitoring. It currently covers Region Sjælland's internal investigation into registration and data flow errors tied to Indikator 8, highlighting organizational efforts to correct underlying infrastructure flaws that affect clinical metrics.

## Pages

- [[quality-improvement-action|Quality Improvement Action]] — Details organizational responses to data reporting challenges, specifically Region Sjælland's investigation into Indikator 8 registration errors.
